sentences.text: 3. The petitioners claim that they are the land losers for establishment of Railway Coach Factory.

The land is acquired by the Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board (for short 'KIADB') and as per the NC: 2024:KHC-K:2168 scheme, the family members of the land losers if educated would be provided suitable job depending on their educational qualification as per the policy of the Central Scheme.

If such family members are not having any education qualification, necessary training would be provided and necessary employment would be provided in the project that is to be implemented in the acquired lands.

Accordingly, the petitioners have given representations to the Railway Coach Factory, who are respondent Nos.3 and 4.
4.

Since the petitioners are the land losers and the lands are acquired by the State Government through KIADB, it is for the Deputy Commissioner and KIADB to consider the representations of the petitioners and pass appropriate orders.
5. Instead of giving representations to the Deputy Commissioner and KIADB, the petitioners have chosen to give representations to respondent Nos.3 and 4, who are only the beneficiaries.

Hence, if the petitioners are directed to furnish the proper representations to the Deputy Commissioner and KIADB, they are bound to consider the representations as per the policy of the Government and pass appropriate orders thereon.
7. Reserving such liberty for the petitioners, the present writ petition stands disposed of.

If any such representations are given by the petitioners within a period of one month from today,
the Deputy Commissioner and the KIADB shall dispose of the same within a period of three months thereof.
